implementation_scope.Apple: Ordinary F32/F16/BF16-to-Bool Cast uses IEEE magnitude bits; reverse Bool Cast and Select normalize any nonzero raw byte. Floating Select retains its original integer-bit payload path.
implementation_scope.Vulkan: Ordinary F32/F16/BF16-to/from-Bool Cast and F16/BF16-to/from-E4M3FN storage bridges. Existing byte-copy Select, BF16 arithmetic and ordinary MatMul retained.

numerical_contract.graph: Original rank3 BF16 A[B,T,K], BF16 last-axis absmax/448; replace exactly zero scale by epsilon1/128, not an epsilon floor. BF16 divide/clamp -> saturated nearest-even E4 -> BF16 reconstruction.
numerical_contract.weight: Original E4 W[N,K] -> BF16 -> multiply BF16 channel scale[N,1] with BF16 rounding; transpose and ordinary F32-accumulating MatMul -> BF16 output.
numerical_contract.non_equivalence: No replacement by a raw FP8 code-dot with scales outside the sum; original intermediate BF16 rounding remains observable.
numerical_contract.primitive_edges: Three floating storage types: +/-zero false; minimum +/-subnormal, +/-Inf and NaN true; arbitrary nonzero Bool bytes restore floating0/1. Broadcast [7,1] mask with [1,3]/[7,1] branches preserves exact selected signedzero/subnormal/NaN payload bits.

architecture: Existing GraphBuilder, cold backend lowering, Program/Invocation, prepare/capture, Completion and output leases. No change to shared scheduling, allocation policy or resource-retirement core.
